svg.title: The zoo: measured models and the tables that hold them
svg.desc: Left: the 44 models measured in this repository's phase-2 runs, placed by median layer alpha and median stable rank and colored by architecture family; fine-tunes sit beside their families. Right: the snapshot under builds/current has seven Parquet tables and a retrieval index, queried offline with find, info, similar, family, diff and check.
svg.text: seven Parquet tables, a retrieval index
and links to full HDF5 spectra
per-layer α, fit quality, HDF5 index
